SELECT SUM(burden_30_to_49_lt_10k+burden_30_to_49_10k_to_20k+burden_30_to_49_20k_to_35k+burden_30_to_49_35k_to_50k+burden_30_to_49_50k_to_75k+burden_30_to_49_75k_to_100k+burden_30_to_49_100k_plus+burden_50_plus_lt_10k+burden_50_plus_10k_to_20k+burden_50_plus_20k_to_35k+burden_50_plus_35k_to_50k+burden_50_plus_50k_to_75k+burden_50_plus_75k_to_100k+burden_50_plus_100k_plus) b, SUM(burden_50_plus_lt_10k+burden_50_plus_10k_to_20k+burden_50_plus_20k_to_35k+burden_50_plus_35k_to_50k+burden_50_plus_50k_to_75k+burden_50_plus_75k_to_100k+burden_50_plus_100k_plus) s, SUM(renter_households_total-burden_not_computed_lt_10k-burden_not_computed_10k_to_20k-burden_not_computed_20k_to_35k-burden_not_computed_35k_to_50k-burden_not_computed_50k_to_75k-burden_not_computed_75k_to_100k-burden_not_computed_100k_plus) d FROM census.acs_rent_burden_by_income WHERE geography='county' AND county_fips IN ('25025','25017','25021','25009','25023') AND year=2024
